items.name: Primary
items.role: The system's primary type and CTA color. Used for h1/h2/h3 display, body text on dark, and primary button labels (the buttons themselves are transparent or can…

items.name: M Blue Light
items.role: The first stop in the M tricolor stripe. Used on M-badge accents and motorsport chrome.

items.name: M Blue Dark
items.role: The middle stop. The same hex as BMW's heritage corporate blue, repurposed as the middle band of the M stripe.

items.name: M Red
items.role: The third stop. The signature M-power red, used in the stripe and on motorsport-pace callouts.

items.name: Electric Blue
items.role: A separate electric-vehicle accent used on M xDrive electric model pages. Distinct from the heritage blue — feels colder, more digital.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: The default page floor across every marketing surface. True black.

items.name: Surface Soft
items.role: A barely-different-from-black used for spec table cells and footer-adjacent strips.

items.name: Surface Elevated
items.role: One step lighter, used for nested cards inside dark bands.

items.name: Carbon Gray
items.role: Carbon-fiber-inspired surface tone used on technical-spec cards.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: The 1px divider tone on dark surfaces. Used between body sections, between table rows, around card outlines.

items.name: Hairline Strong
items.role: Same hex as borders feel like one-step elevations rather than ink lines.

items.name: Ink / On Dark
items.role: All headline and primary text on dark canvas.

items.name: Body
items.role: Default running-text color (slightly cooler than pure white). Used for body paragraphs and secondary metadata.

items.name: Warning
items.role: Used very sparingly on technical-warning callouts.
